claim: 규칙은 문자규칙(A~G)이 원칙을, 번호규칙(I~XXIII)이 구체적 항목을 정하고, 둘이 부딪치면 번호규칙이 우선합니다(해석규칙).
evidence: https://www.trans-lex.org/720020/ Rule of Interpretation: "Except as provided by the Rule Paramount and the numbered Rules, general average shall be adjusted according to the lettered Rules." Rule Paramount: "In no case shall there be any allowance for sacrifice or expenditure unless reasonably made or incurred." 번호규칙 우선은 맞지만 최상위 규칙(Rule Paramount)이 빠짐.
fix: 규칙은 문자규칙(A~G)이 원칙을, 번호규칙(I~XXIII)이 구체적 항목을 정하고, 둘이 부딪치면 번호규칙이 우선합니다(해석규칙). 그 위에 "합리적으로 치르지 않은 희생·비용은 어떤 경우에도 인정하지 않는다"는 최상위 규칙(Rule Paramount)이 있습니다.

claim: 공동의 항해에 관련된 재산을 위험에서 지키려고 공동의 안전을 위해 이례적인 희생이나 비용을 "고의로, 합리적으로" 치른 때, 그리고 그때에만 공동해손 행위가 있음
evidence: https://www.trans-lex.org/720020/ Rule A 1: "There is a general average act when, and only when, any extraordinary sacrifice or expenditure is intentionally and reasonably made or incurred for the common safety for the purpose of preserving from peril the property involved in a common maritime adventure."

evidence: https://www.trans-lex.org/720020/ Rule C 1-3: "Only such losses, damages or expenses which are the direct consequence of the general average act…"; "…damage to the environment…"; "Demurrage, loss of market, and any loss or damage sustained or expense incurred by reason of delay…"

evidence: https://www.trans-lex.org/720020/ Rule D: "Rights to contribution in general average shall not be affected, though the event … may have been due to the fault of one of the parties …, but this shall not prejudice any remedies or defences which may be open against or to that party in respect of such fault."

evidence: https://www.trans-lex.org/720020/ Rule XVII(a)(i): "…made upon the actual net values of the property at the termination of the common maritime adventure…"; (a)(ii): "Any cargo may be excluded from contributing to general average should the average adjuster consider that the cost of including it in the adjustment would be likely to be disproportionate to its eventual contribution." (a)(ii)는 양하 전 멸실·손상분을 공제하므로 '유실 화물은 분담 가액에 없음' 설명도 맞음.
